preconditions.expression: all(c.isupper() or c.isdigit() or c in {' ', 'O', 'S'} for c in input_string)
preconditions.description: The input string contains only uppercase letters, digits, spaces, 'O', or 'S'.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'ABCDEF0123456789OS' for c in input_string.replace(' ', ''))
preconditions.description: Each non-space character in the input string is either a valid hex digit (A-F, 0-9), 'O', or 'S'.

postconditions.expression: return_value == sum(int(word.replace('O', '0').replace('S', '5'), 16) for word in input_string.split() if all(c in 'ABCDEF0123456789' for c in word.replace('O', '0').replace('S', '5')))
postconditions.description: The return value is the sum of the decimal values of all words in the input string that can be interpreted as valid hex values after substituting 'O' with '0' and 'S' with '5'.
